item.title: My pipeline ran out of memory at 149k jobs. Now it fetches 400k in under 3.5 GB
item.description: The daily jobs pipeline was killed by its GitHub runner at 7.2 GB. Measuring, fingerprints and streaming to disk brought the peak under 3.5 GB while the dataset grew past 400,000 jobs.

item.title: When a job disappears: did it close, or did my pipeline fail?
item.description: A missing job posting can mean a closed role, a failed collection, or an incomplete feed. Here is how my remote jobs pipeline handles that uncertainty.

item.title: Only 9% of open jobs are fully remote. Here is where they are
item.description: We counted 268,835 open positions from 11,041 companies. Fewer than one in ten is fully remote, and the share changes a lot from one country to another.
